fusions.name: Seam Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Helm Denter
fusions.desc: Launches a hard-shelled bolt at the first enemy in a line up to 8 tiles away that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite, and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shell Up
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds and hops you 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Uncrushable
fusions.desc: Once every 240 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
